title: Traffic-shadowed region cutover validation with state fencing and automated rollback
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Build an automated, low-risk cutover validation workflow for Private (VPC) multi-region deployments that exercises network, stateful services, and upgrade paths without impacting production traffic. The flow will use traffic shadowing (mirror), fenced state handoff for leader-elected services, incremental DNS/BGP weight changes, and automated rollback criteria. Deliverables: Terraform modules to orchestrate shadowing and fencing, a parameterized runbook that can be executed by SRE/SEs, Canary verification jobs (synthetic + model-level checks), and integration with existing rollout orchestration so canaries can be promoted to cutover or aborted automatically.
objective: Enable safe, repeatable private deployment failover drills and cutovers in customer VPCs by automating validation steps and safety gates so that runbook execution time is under 60 minutes and false-positive rollbacks are <2%.
proposed_solution: 1) Terraform modules: create 'tf-module/prov-shadow' to provision mirror load-balancers, route-table weights, and peering controls; and 'tf-module/state-fence' to create leader lock resources, persistent checkpoint snapshots (object-store or database export jobs), and reclamation fences. 2) Orchestration: a controller (K8s job or Lambda) that sequences: enable shadowing -> run canaries -> fencing handshake -> switch weights -> post-cutover validation -> finalize or rollback. 3) Health checks: end-to-end synthetic flows (model inference checks), KV-consistency probes, DB replication lag thresholds, and TLS cert checks. 4) Rollback policy: automated rollback on SLO breaches or data-mismatch checks; manual approval gate for metrics borderline cases. 5) Observability: dedicate dashboards showing shadow vs primary latency, error delta, token throughput, and checkpoint integrity. 6) Tests: unit tests for terraform modules, integration tests in staging that spin up a 2-region private stack and run the full sequence with injected failures.
runbook_steps: Provision shadow infra in target region using tf-module/prov-shadow (LBs, peering, route-weights)
Start traffic-shadowing: mirror a sampled 1% of production traffic to the target region (header-tagged requests)
Run 30-minute synthetic canary suite against mirrored path: model output checksum, latency P95 < 1.5x baseline, error rate < 0.5%
If canary passes, initiate state fencing: acquire leader lock in source region and export KV cache snapshot and DB checkpoint to target region storage
Validate checkpoint integrity and replay a bounded subset of requests against the target region to confirm idempotency and correctness
Gradually shift routing: increase BGP/DNS weight in 10% increments with 5-minute observation windows
At each increment, run quick health probes (inference smoke, auth, internal RPC) and compare metrics against thresholds
When traffic reaches >90% and metrics stable for 15 minutes, run final consistency scan, release leader lock, and mark target as primary
If any critical check fails, invoke automated rollback: revert route weights, purge partial state replicas if necessary, and re-open leader in source region
Tear down shadow infra within configurable retention window or keep as warm standby depending on runbook parameters
health_checks: Model output signature: deterministic fields present and token-length within expected range
End-to-end latency: P95 target region <= 1.5x source P95
Error budget delta: increase from baseline <= 0.5%
DB replication lag: < 5s for synchronous paths or within configured lag threshold for async
KV cache hit rate: within 10% of source region's baseline
Auth token validation: no TLS/cert mismatch and JWT validation success
Ingress e2e checks: request roundtrip success for 99% of synthetic samples
rollback_criteria: Canary failure: any synthetic job returns model output checksum mismatch
SLO breach: sustained P95 latency > configured threshold for 3 consecutive windows
Error spike: 5xx rate increases by >1% absolute and persists for two observation windows
Data mismatch: checkpoint replay reports >0.1% inconsistency on sampled keys
Manual abort: on-call or Runbook owner clicks 'abort' in orchestration UI
acceptance_criteria: Terraform modules pass linting + unit tests and publish version tags
End-to-end staging drill completes within 60 minutes using the automated runbook and post-run metrics captured
Automated rollback triggers and completes cleanly in a simulated failure scenario
Dashboards show shadow vs primary metrics and an SLO-aware toggle in Console for runbook runs
Runbook documentation (Confluence link) reviewed and approved by Security and SRE
Playbook parameters expose safe defaults and a clear manual approval step for production runs
